discription: A warm and evolving pad sound using detuned saw waves and a low-pass filter with a smooth ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1,attack=2.0, decay=0.8, sustain=0.7, release=3.0,cutoff=8000, rq=0.5, detune=0.005;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);var osc1 = Saw.ar(freq);var osc2 = Saw.ar(freq * (1 + detune));var osc3 = Saw.ar(freq * (1 - detune));sig = (osc1 + osc2 + osc3) / 3;sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff);sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
